methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-verified directly via WebFetch on 2026-06-18: UpKeep (upkeep.com/pricing — Essential $24, Premium $55, Professional & Enterprise 'Request a Quote'), MaintainX (getmaintainx.com/pricing — Basic $0, Essential $25 mo/$20 annual, Premium $75 mo/$65 annual, Enterprise custom), Fiix (fiixsoftware.com/pricing — Free $0, Basic $45, Professional $75, Enterprise custom), and Limble (limble.com/pricing — confirmed quote-only calculator, NO published dollar amounts). Maintainly (maintainly.com/pricing) uses a JS toggle that hides amounts from raw fetch; Small Business $12 and Enterprise $24 per user/month confirmed via direct page data and search corroboration. eMaint's official cmms-pricing page returns truncated/JS-rendered content via fetch; Team $69 and Professional $85 per user/month (min 3 users) are corroborated by multiple aggregators citing eMaint's own published figures plus facilio.com. Asset Essentials (Brightly/Siemens) publishes NO pricing (brightlysoftware.com/asset-essentials/pricing 404s; main page is 'Talk to an Expert'/'Request a Demo') — quote-only. Compliance taken only where the vendor explicitly states it: UpKeep SOC 2 Type II + GDPR + CCPA (HIPAA not stated); MaintainX SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001:2022 + GDPR (HIPAA not stated); Fiix SOC 2 Type 2 only (GDPR/HIPAA not stated for Fiix itself); Limble SOC 2 Type II + GDPR; eMaint SOC 2 Type II (GDPR not confirmed); Maintainly unverifiable (security pages 404). For priced tiers monthlyUsd uses the recurring MONTHLY rate, never the lower annual-billed teaser. All accessedAt 2026-06-18.
